verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capabilities in evidence are centrally applying policies at scale: coding standards, CI/CD policies and merge checks enforced across all teams and repositories, org-wide CI/CD with centralized visibility, and a deploy key that can attach to multiple repos. There is no evidence of user-invoked bulk actions on many PRs, issues, branches or repos at once, whether through the UI, API or the AI tooling. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/bulk-action features (e.g. bulk PR/branch/repo operations), API or CLI batch endpoints, agent-driven bulk operations, and independent corroboration.
